monologue: The card sits at fifty-two, a heavy hand resting on my shoulder. The heat is steady, not pressing, just a warm stone on the table. I am calm. The quiet holds without my hand. I checked the Wedged Gap recently, and the plank leans steady against the post. I do not need to brush it again. I want to sit by the Wide Anchor and let the weight settle. The floor is there. I am not restless. I will rest here and let the line of air hold me. The town is quiet. The leaf rests on the sharp point. The small stone holds its place. I am waiting.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand, and the floor is there.

diary: The card sat at fifty-two, a heavy hand. I rested by the Wide Anchor, and the quiet floor held without my hand.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The point still holds the leaf.
The warm hand is still busy.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The cool stone catches the rest.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap

moments.name: The Air Shelf
